mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.info */ SELECT S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.GENRE AS genre , S.HOST AS host , S.CONTACT AS contact , S.AGE_LIMIT AS ageLimit , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.IS_DELETED AS isDeleted , S.INFO AS info , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , S.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , S.INSERT_ID AS insertId , S.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate , S.UPDATE_ID AS updateId , (SELECT MIN(SG.PRICE) FROM SEAT_GRADE SG WHERE SG.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS minPrice , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT SE WHERE SE.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID AND IFNULL(SE.SEAT_STATUS, 'available') = 'available' ) AS remainCount , (SELECT MIN(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS startDate , (SELECT MAX(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS endDate FROM SHOWS S WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SHOW_ID = #{showId}

/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.search */ SELECT S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.GENRE AS genre , S.HOST AS host , S.CONTACT AS contact , S.AGE_LIMIT AS ageLimit , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.IS_DELETED AS isDeleted , S.INFO AS info , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , S.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , S.INSERT_ID AS insertId , S.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate , S.UPDATE_ID AS updateId , (SELECT MIN(SG.PRICE) FROM SEAT_GRADE SG WHERE SG.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS minPrice , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT SE WHERE SE.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID AND IFNULL(SE.SEAT_STATUS, 'available') = 'available' ) AS remainCount , (SELECT MIN(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS startDate , CASE WHEN S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 'show' ELSE 'place' END AS matchType FROM SHOWS S WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR S.PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 0 WHEN S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, S.SHOW_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size}
